verdict.rationale: User dry-ran the plan's factory + tests, confirmed 4/4 pass and 3/4 correctly fail under shared-state regression; requested and got a 5th test for export-intact + byte-for-byte body preservation note; approved to proceed.

CR-001 (spinner interval not cancelled on renderSteps re-render -- functional bug: spinners.has(id) stays true forever after re-render, permanently blocking startSpinner/icon updates for that row id) and CR-002 (showApproval re-entry after stampApproval shows stale buttons next to the stamp -- cosmetic, self-correcting on click) both verified present identically in pre-refactor ui/steps-ui.js on codemie-desktop. Neither introduced by this diff; fixing either would violate the ticket's byte-for-byte body preservation constraint and mix behavior changes into a structural-only refactor. Accepted as pre-existing, tracked as follow-up (CR-001 warrants its own ticket + re-render-while-spinning test if the step panel isn't replaced by a later FE ticket; CR-002 not worth a ticket).

Skipped per explicit ticket instruction: this is a Tauri desktop app with no browser surface -- feature-verification-runner drives a browser, which does not apply. qa-gates (npm test 24/24) is the verification for this JS-only structural refactor. DoD manual check (open legacy install wizard, confirm step list still renders/updates) done via code review + test coverage of the default-instance re-export contract, since renderer.js is unchanged and the default instance behavior is identical to the pre-refactor module.
